b1-32-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Were You Late?
b1-32-01.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks why you arrived late to dinner in Budapest. There was a lot of snow and the trams were slow.
b1-32-01.prompt: Tell Meg why you were late.
cues: Give the cause using a connector
b1-32-01.target: Llegué tarde a la cena debido a la nieve.
b1-32-01.english: I arrived late to dinner because of the snow.
b1-32-01.canDo: I can explain causes and reasons clearly.

b1-32-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Cancelled Dinner
b1-32-02.scenario: You are Meg. Your sister Kaylee asks on a call why you and Carlos cancelled dinner with friends. The train was late and you had little time.
b1-32-02.prompt: Tell Kaylee what happened and what the result was.
cues: Say what you did as a result
b1-32-02.target: El tren llegó tarde, por eso cancelamos la cena.
b1-32-02.english: The train was late, so we cancelled dinner.
b1-32-02.canDo: I can explain consequences and results.

b1-32-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Studying Despite Work
b1-32-03.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks how you find time for Spanish with your job at the office in Budapest. You work a lot, but you study every day.
b1-32-03.prompt: Tell Meg that you study Spanish although you work a lot.
cues: Say that you work a lot
b1-32-03.target: A pesar de que trabajo mucho en la oficina, estudio español todos los días.
b1-32-03.english: Although I work a lot at the office, I study Spanish every day.
b1-32-03.canDo: I can contrast ideas and concede a point.

b1-32-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Why Spanish?
b1-32-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks why you practise Spanish every day. You want to talk with his grandmother in Madrid, and you want her to understand you.
b1-32-04.prompt: Tell Carlos what you study for and why.
cues: Say whom you want to talk to
b1-32-04.target: Estudio español para hablar con tu abuela de Madrid y para que ella me entienda.
b1-32-04.english: I study Spanish to talk with your grandmother in Madrid and so that she understands me.
b1-32-04.canDo: I can explain purposes and objectives.

b1-32-05.title: Communicative Challenge: An Article About Habits
b1-32-05.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what the article you read says. The writer asks why people in his city stroll in the evening and not in the morning: in the morning almost everyone works, and at midday it is hot.
b1-32-05.prompt: Tell Meg what the writer asks and what reasons he gives.
cues: Give the reason for the morning
Give the reason for the midday
b1-32-05.target: El autor se pregunta por qué la gente pasea por la tarde. Por la mañana casi todos trabajan y a mediodía hace calor, así que esperan hasta la tarde.
b1-32-05.english: The writer asks why people stroll in the evening. In the morning almost everyone works and at midday it is hot, so they wait until the evening.
b1-32-05.canDo: I can build a connected argument.

b1-32-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Moving Flats
b1-32-consolidation.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks what you think about moving to a flat in the centre of Budapest. It is expensive, but it is close to his office and to your university.
b1-32-consolidation.prompt: Give Carlos your argument for and against the flat.
cues: Contrast it with a good point
b1-32-consolidation.target: El piso del centro es caro; sin embargo, está cerca de tu oficina y de mis clases. Por eso creo que es una buena idea.
b1-32-consolidation.english: The flat in the centre is expensive; however, it is close to your office and my university. So I think it is a good idea.
b1-32-consolidation.canDo: I can use the main connectors of the unit.
